old_holdout_role: 2024/25 is already inspected; never reuse it to validate the filtering policy. Its out-of-time predictions may calibrate a strictly later season.

stress.meaning: sensitivity scenarios, not a statistical confidence interval

candidate_search.ranking: Among qualified candidates only, maximize coverage; tie-break by validation date-cluster lower accuracy bound, then stable candidate id

confirmation.note: Passing supports the predeclared selective accuracy target on this sample; it is not proof the underlying future hit rate exceeds 80%.

interpretation: All filtering metrics are conditional on accepted, date-batched source records. Models share data and features; agreement is not independent corroboration. Selection is immutable before evaluating the new test. Failure means insufficient evidence, never silently relax gates.
